items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: I don't know these boys only by reputation who are, the boys who are with Basie and Duke

ctx.x: You of course heard a lot of King Oliver and Freddie Keppard, and of course Louis Armstrong, all of those New Orleans trumpet players, so many great ones that I don't know which one you can pick. Oh yes, there are a lot of
new fellas now, I don't know these boys only by reputation who are, the boys who are with Basie and Duke, oh those boys are just
wonderful, marvelous. Yeah they have a lot of technique and range, but I still don't think they have quite a tone. Oh my yeah, but it brings us back to what we were
